data.desc: Armlogi Holding Corp., based in Walnut, CA, is a U.S.-based warehousing and logistics service provider offering a comprehensive suite of supply-chain solutions, including warehouse management and order fulfillment. The Company caters to cross-border e-commerce merchants seeking to establish U.S. market warehouses. With 11 warehouses totaling approximately 3.8 million square feet, the Company offers one-stop warehousing and logistics services. The Company's warehouses are equipped with facilities and technology to handle and store large, bulky items.
